trials.title: Efficacy and Safety of Lorundrostat in Subjects With Uncontrolled and Resistant Hypertension

primaryOutcomes.measure: Change from baseline in automated office BP (AOBP) SBP at Week 6 in subjects randomized to lorundrostat 50 mg QD compared to subjects randomized to placebo

reasons: one of only 1 trials at this company

signals.text: Enrollment finalized at 1,083 vs original target 1,000 (+8%)
No results posted 23 months after primary completion (Dec 2024)
signals.read: Past the 12-month FDAAA window. Delayed posting skews toward negative or unflattering results.

trials.commentary: Ph 3, randomized, double-blind. Enrolled 1,083 vs 1,000 at registration (+8%). Started Nov 2023 (planned Dec 2023), primary completion Dec 2024 vs Mar 2025 at registration (-3 mo, 1 moves). Recruiting opened Dec 2023, enrollment closed Nov 2024 (11 mo recruiting), completed Feb 2025.
